GET /api/auth/me - Get current user with valid token (100%)
POST /api/payments/checkout - Stripe checkout session creation for basic/premium plans (100%)
GET /api/plans/available - Returns 3 plans with correct pricing (100%)
GET /api/plans/current - Returns user plan with limits and usage (100%)
